picks.why: The house is bigger and fills more of the frame, like the close-cropped real lighthouse. Candidate 1 sits small and far back. Both have the same moon and trees.
This hat is the largest and has the clearest brim and curled tip, closest to how tightly the real cap is framed. 1 and 3 are smaller.
The only candidate. It reads instantly as a pumpkin, has true proportions, fills the frame and adds no extras.
This cauldron is the largest and best fills the frame, matching how the real boxing gloves fill theirs. 1 and 3 sit smaller with more empty floor.
This coffin is the largest and boldest. The other two are slightly smaller with more empty sky. All three carry the same small extras (moon, gravestone).
The only candidate. A plain gravestone with a believable shape and only light moss and a flower.
This candelabra is the largest in frame with clean, even candles. 3 adds dripping wax and 1 sits smaller.
This ball and stand are the largest, filling the frame like the real drink glass. 1 and 3 are pushed back with more empty background.
The only candidate. It reads instantly as a black cat, sits in a simple setting and has no invented extras.
The longer handle gives a true broom shape and spans the frame diagonally. Candidate 1 is a short, stubby broom.
